verdict.rationale: AMD documents official Linux OS support and extensive ROCm Linux driver/software stack for the RX 9070 XT, including PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX/ONNX, vLLM, SGLang, and Docker workflows targeting gfx1201 specifically. However, all evidence is first-party AMD documentation with no independent Linux benchmark/testing reports or community hands-on corroboration included in the pack. Missing for 10: independent Linux reviews/benchmarks of this specific card, community reports on driver stability/quality on Linux, and any third-party corroboration beyond AMD's own docs.
